name: git-branch
description: Recut a branch's history into atomic commits — collapse it with a soft reset, rebuild it one logical change at a time with messages drawn from the original commits, the pull request, its tickets, and the session that wrote the code, prove the resulting tree is byte-identical to what it replaced, and gate every commit through the project's own checks — plus an editor-free interactive-rebase toolkit for reordering, squashing, and verifying history from an agent shell with no TTY
